scenarios.title: Area habitat — Retained
scenarios.description: Every area parcel is retained: proposed state mirrors the baseline.

scenarios.title: Area habitat — Enhanced
scenarios.description: Area parcels are enhanced from Moderate to Good condition (same habitat).

scenarios.title: Area habitat — Created
scenarios.description: Area parcels are created (written to the gpkg as the statutory 'Lost' retention).

scenarios.title: Hedgerow — Retained
scenarios.description: The first hedgerow is retained; area parcels tile the redline.

scenarios.title: Hedgerow — Enhanced
scenarios.description: The first hedgerow is enhanced from Moderate to Good condition.

scenarios.title: Hedgerow — Created
scenarios.description: The first hedgerow is created; its baseline columns take the template placeholders.

scenarios.title: Watercourse — Retained
scenarios.description: The first watercourse is retained, with no encroachment.

scenarios.title: Watercourse — Enhanced
scenarios.description: The first watercourse is enhanced from Moderate to Good condition.

scenarios.title: Watercourse — Created
scenarios.description: The first watercourse is created; its baseline columns take the template placeholders.

scenarios.title: Area habitat — enhancement that lowers condition
scenarios.description: H001 is "enhanced" from Moderate to Poor condition, same habitat. The metric does not allow an enhancement to reduce condition.

scenarios.title: Area habitat — enhancement that changes nothing
scenarios.description: H001 is "enhanced" with the same habitat and the same Moderate condition — an enhancement that enhances nothing.

scenarios.title: Area habitat — enhancement to a lower distinctiveness
scenarios.description: H001 is "enhanced" from a Medium-distinctiveness habitat to a Low one. An enhancement may not trade down.

scenarios.title: Created habitat — both advance and delay years
scenarios.description: H001 is created 2 years in advance and also delayed by 3 years. The metric allows one or the other, never both.

subject.note: created parcel with advance and delay both set

scenarios.title: Hedgerow — enhancement that lowers condition
scenarios.description: Every hedgerow is "enhanced" from Good to Poor condition. The metric does not allow an enhancement to reduce condition.

scenarios.title: Watercourse — an enhanced culvert
scenarios.description: R001 is a culvert, "enhanced" in place. The metric has no enhancement for a culvert: its enhancement sheet does not offer the type at all.

scenarios.title: Watercourse — enhancement that worsens encroachment
scenarios.description: Both ditches are "enhanced" to Good condition while their encroachment goes from none to Major on the channel and both banks, so the enhancement delivers fewer units than the baseline.

scenarios.title: Area habitats across every condition band
scenarios.description: Five retained parcels, each pinned to a different condition (Good → Poor), same habitat.

scenarios.title: Area habitats across every strategic-significance band
scenarios.description: Three retained parcels pinned to Low (1), Medium and High strategic significance.

subject.note: H001 Low (1), H002 Medium, H003 High strategic significance

scenarios.title: Net gain met (≥ 10%)
scenarios.description: Every parcel enhanced from Low-distinctiveness/Poor to Medium-distinctiveness/Good — a large, unambiguous gain.

subject.note: enhanced parcels driving a net gain over 10%

scenarios.title: Net gain unmet (< 10%)
scenarios.description: Every parcel retained unchanged — zero net change, so the 10% gain is not met.

subject.note: retained parcels with no net gain

scenarios.title: Trading rules — Low → Medium distinctiveness
scenarios.description: Parcels enhanced from a Low-distinctiveness habitat to a Medium-distinctiveness one, exercising the low→medium trading rule.

scenarios.title: Trading rules — nothing lost, every rule met
scenarios.description: Control. Area: parcels retained and one enhanced. Hedgerows: retained and one enhanced. Watercourses: a canal retained, a ditch enhanced. Every trading rule is met.

subject.note: the first area parcel; see the description for every layer

scenarios.title: Trading rules — like-for-like replacement, enough units
scenarios.description: Area: a Medium grassland is lost and two Medium grasslands created (same broad habitat). Hedgerows: a Medium hedgerow in Poor condition is lost and two Medium hedgerows created. Watercourses: a poor, encroached ditch is lost and a ditch in Good condition created. Every rule is met.

subject.note: the first area parcel; see the description for every layer

scenarios.title: Trading rules — right habitat, too few units
scenarios.description: Area: a Medium grassland is replaced one-for-one by another Medium grassland, which, discounted for the years it takes to reach condition, delivers fewer units than were lost. Hedgerows: a Medium hedgerow in Good condition is replaced by another planted ten years late and left in Poor condition. Watercourses: a ditch is replaced by one dug ten years late and left in Poor condition. Each replacement is the right habitat but too small a one, so each Medium rule is breached.

subject.note: the first area parcel; see the description for every layer

scenarios.title: Trading rules — enough units, wrong habitat
scenarios.description: Area: a Medium grassland is lost and two Medium heathlands created — more units than were lost, but a different broad habitat. Hedgerows: a Medium hedgerow is lost and two Low hedgerows created. Watercourses: a poor, encroached ditch is lost and a canal created. Each Medium rule is breached however many units the replacement brings.

subject.note: the first area parcel; see the description for every layer

scenarios.title: Trading rules — replaced by a lower distinctiveness
scenarios.description: Area: a Medium grassland is replaced by a Low one. Hedgerows: a Low hedgerow is replaced by two non-native (Very Low) hedgerows. Watercourses: a ditch (Medium) is replaced by a culvert (Low). The rule for the band that was lost is breached — a surplus lower down never makes good a loss higher up.

subject.note: the first area parcel; see the description for every layer

scenarios.title: Trading rules — replaced by a higher distinctiveness
scenarios.description: Area: a Low grassland is replaced by a Medium one. Hedgerows: a Low hedgerow is replaced by two Medium hedgerows. Watercourses: a culvert (Low) is replaced by a ditch (Medium). Trading up is always allowed, so every rule is met.

subject.note: the first area parcel; see the description for every layer

scenarios.title: Trading rules — Low replaced by Low in another habitat
scenarios.description: Area: a Low grassland is replaced by Low urban allotments — a different broad habitat, which the Low rule allows. Hedgerows: a non-native (Very Low) hedgerow is replaced by a native one (Low). Both rules are met.

subject.note: the first area parcel; see the description for every layer

scenarios.title: Trading rules — lost to development, nothing in its place
scenarios.description: Area: a Low grassland is built over (Very Low sealed surface, which the metric gives no units). Hedgerows: a non-native (Very Low) hedgerow is removed. Nothing replaces either, so the Low area rule and the Very Low hedgerow rule are breached.

subject.note: the first area parcel; see the description for every layer

scenarios.title: Trading rules — a Low deficit made good by a Medium surplus
scenarios.description: Area: a Low grassland is built over, while two Medium grasslands are improved from Poor to Good. Hedgerows: a Low hedgerow is lost while two Medium hedgerows are improved. A surplus may be carried down to a lower band, so every rule is met.

subject.note: the first area parcel; see the description for every layer

scenarios.title: Trading rules — a Medium deficit beside a Low surplus
scenarios.description: Area: a Medium grassland is replaced by a Low one, while two Low grasslands are improved from Poor to Good. Hedgerows: a Medium hedgerow is lost while two Low hedgerows are improved. A surplus cannot be carried up, so the Medium rules are breached and the Low ones met.

subject.note: the first area parcel; see the description for every layer

scenarios.title: Trading rules — a Medium surplus in one broad habitat, a deficit in another
scenarios.description: Area: three Medium grasslands are improved from Poor to Good, a large Medium surplus, while a Medium heathland is replaced by a Low grassland. The Medium rule is met habitat by habitat, so the grassland surplus cannot make good the heathland loss and the rule is breached despite the net gain.

subject.note: the first area parcel; see the description for every layer

scenarios.title: Trading rules — a Low deficit made good by a Medium surplus, beside a Medium deficit
scenarios.description: Area: a Low grassland is enhanced into a Medium one, so the Low band loses units and the Medium grassland gains more, while two Medium heathlands are built over. The heathland deficit breaches the Medium rule, as no other Medium broad habitat may make it good, but the grassland surplus still covers the Low loss, so the Low rule is met. This is the case the published metric gets wrong: it nets the heathland deficit off the grassland surplus before offering it to the Low band, and so reports the Low rule breached. The workbooks correct that bug (METRIC_CORRECTIONS in the workbook writer).

subject.note: the Low grassland enhanced into a Medium one; see the description

scenarios.title: Created habitat — advance years
scenarios.description: Created parcels with habitat creation started 5 years in advance (delay 0).

scenarios.title: Created habitat — delay years
scenarios.description: Created parcels with habitat creation delayed by 3 years (advance 0).

scenarios.title: Complete post-intervention data
scenarios.description: Every enhanced parcel has all proposed attributes populated — a clean, complete file.

scenarios.title: Invalid: mixed complete and incomplete data
scenarios.description: Deliberately invalid. The first three parcels are complete; the last three are enhancements with a blank proposed condition and strategic significance, which the metric does not accept, so those rows generate no units.
